'''Hollé'''<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] culture of Humans<ref name="SoN Handmaidens" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="SoN">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> who served as a handmaiden in the [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|Naboo Royal Handmaidens]] of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]].<ref name="DaG" /> Hollé had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light skin<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> and in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], which took place in<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="CSWE Theed">{{CSWECite|III|325|Theed}}</ref> [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. At the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]], Hollé walked behind [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]], next to fellow handmaiden [[Umé/Legends|Umé]], wearing a red [[Robe/Legends|robe]] with a hood.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hollé first appeared the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], released in [[2005]].<ref name="ROTS" /> The funeral scene that featured the character was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Hollé was identified by name in the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" department in the [[Star Wars Insider 142|142nd]] edition of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'', written by [[Leland Chee]]<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> and released on [[June 11]], [[2013]].<ref name="SWI 142 release date">[[Star Wars Insider 141|''Star Wars Insider'' 141]]</ref>
